goal: Find a path to 10x or greater speedup of simulate!() while preserving mathematical correctness, physical fidelity, and API flexibility. All GPU code MUST use AcceleratedKernels.jl. ALL speedup claims MUST be backed by Metal GPU benchmarks.
v1_lesson: v1 spent 5 iterations on static analysis and CPU benchmarks. The resulting optimizations produced ZERO speedup on Metal GPU. v2 requires GPU benchmarks for every claim.

context.scope: simulate!() ONLY — forward projection + detector physics pipeline. Reconstruction (reconstruct!) is OUT OF SCOPE.
context.architecture: AcceleratedKernels.jl (AK.jl) for GPU-agnostic execution (Metal/CUDA/ROCm/CPU). Zero-allocation workspace pattern. Polychromatic via sequential energy bin loop.
context.hard_constraint: AcceleratedKernels.jl is NON-NEGOTIABLE. All GPU compute must go through AK.jl. No backend-specific kernels.
context.math_constraint: Same mathematical results (within floating-point tolerance). Same API. Same physics fidelity.
context.gpu_constraint: ALL performance measurements on Metal GPU with Metal.@sync + @elapsed. CPU-only benchmarks are NOT acceptable evidence.

topics.title: GPU Profiling Baseline — Metal @elapsed on every component of simulate!()
topics.notes: MUST be done first. Also profile v1 changes (fused vs unfused, separable vs 2D scatter) to see what actually helps on GPU.
